text: きょうは　おにいさん　ポケモンとの　たたかいかたを　せつめい　しに　きたよー！

structure.jp: ポケモンとの　たたかいかたを
せつめい　しに　きたよー！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: せつめい　しに　きた
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off before ます plus に, followed by a word for coming or going, tells what you came to do. せつめい　しに　きた = 'came to explain'.

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた added to a verb cut off before ます means 'the way to do it'. たたかいかた = 'how to battle'.
